model: integrate_v3.py (v2 scenario tree + m8 industrial-closure path, shared capability latent, D-dependent P(S5|S4))
interval_semantics: mc_ci95_bootstrap = bootstrap over outer (epistemic) draws of the mean: Monte Carlo precision only. epistemic_ci95 = 2.5-97.5% quantiles of per-draw probabilities across parameter draws (each draw = 200 inner paths over only 8 m8 aleatory replicates, so this raw range INCLUDES replicate noise and overstates epistemic spread). epistemic_ci95_denoised = same after shrinking per-draw values toward the mean by sqrt(1 - noise_var/total_var), noise estimated from the replicate structure (audit fix). Structural range = spread across variants.

_labels.broad_analog: S1->S2->S4->S5 while the ruling coalition still needs human staff (v2 m5 analogs)

_labels.closure_after_S2_not_required: single-actor closure path; S2 had occurred but no S4 in that bloc was needed

v2_to_v3_changes: Removed Ppg_med=0.025 and pg_s5_mult=0.5. Replaced by m8 per-draw closure path: actor-level D_core/D_full threshold years, US narrow power grab, post-closure elite choice and S5 timing/channel. Runs in parallel; S2 not required.

S1 timing: m1 CDF mixture (long-run GPT-diffusion anchors, prior-only/pooled/anchors) replaced by first year US or China bloc has D_full<0.5 in the same m8 replicate + lognormal lag (median 2y) to economy-wide lock-in, x m1's P(event|depth)=0.849 (pacts, frictions, benevolent firms, regulation; coupled to z_inst). Evidence for the lag: low (judgment); variants lag 0 and D_full<0.2.

Brakes removed or replaced with m8's evidence-based versions: cognitive plateau 25% -> 12% (Metaculus/expert no-AGI-this-century mass); physical plateau 25% -> 10%; no AI->robotics coupling -> kc lognormal(0.5); no self-replication -> Td_auto ~1y once the robot supply chain is automated (Forethought, theory) with mine/fab doubling floors 3y/2y; adoption lags fitted to 2023-26 AEI/RPS (tau_cog 4y) and retooling cycles (tau_phys 7y) instead of 20-40y diffusion; demand-feedback brake U(0.85,1) removed because m2 (the dedicated model) finds automation accelerates (+1.1%, 0 paths slowed >2%).

Shared capability latent: z_cap = normal score of the draw's m8 capability speed (t_AC 0.6, t_dexterity 0.4). Drives S1 timing (same replicate), S2 lag and probability, S3, Alt B, S4/S5 cap couplings, AGI year (= m8 automated coder + 1y) and background AI takeover exposure.

P(S5|S4): m5 analogs (human-staffed state and army) apply only before the jurisdiction's actor reaches D_core<0.2. A repression regime alive at closure, or formed after it, gets m8's autocratic elite-calculus outcome (China: m8 baseline; US: m8 baseline if a grab already happened, else a counterfactual m8 run on the same replicate with the US bloc autocratic). Exits (reform, coup, external) after closure are superseded.

New non-lethal channel for the closure path: fertility suppression under autocratic warehousing, P ~ Beta(1.2,22.8) (mean 5%), 15-25y to reach 10% below counterfactual. Evidence low (one-child policy framed population as an economic burden; Xinjiang birth-rate falls 2015-18; India 1975-77 sterilizations; all in regimes that still needed labor).
S5 channel split reported (active killing vs lethal neglect), plus public disempowered / held without rights.

Everything else (all PRIORS, walls, feedback-zero, coalition size) is epistemic and shared by the draw's replicates.
constants_sources.US autocratic counterfactual: same m8 replicate with u_grab[US] = -1 (grab at t0): identical D path (D dynamics do not depend on regime), autocratic coalition game for the US bloc.
constants_sources.s1_lag lognormal(2y, 0.6): judgment (low): full-chain depth vs >=50% of employment and >=80% automated-firm output; m1's own event-minus-depth gap is 0 years, chain excludes health/education/personal services.
constants_sources.agi_lag 1y: m8 fb calibration: AC->ASI median ~1.5y; judgment.
constants_sources.fertility suppression Beta(1.2,22.8), la: low evidence; demographic arithmetic: at TFR~1-1.5 births are 0.6-1%/yr of population, so 10% below counterfactual needs most births suppressed for 15-20y.
constants_sources.v2 constants retained: S2|S1, S2b, S3, Alt A/B, m4 S4, m5 analogs (pre-closure), background AI and non-AI catastrophe hazards: as archive_v2/integrate.py.

notes: End-state precedence: S7 > S6->misaligned > S6 > S5 active > S5 neglect > S5b > AI takeover > non-AI catastrophe > held without rights after closure > broad S4 persisting > US grab persisting > Alt B > Alt A > other (S4 ended by coup/external, US S4 pending) > S2 accommodated > closure served > S1 only > no race.
S5 = >=10% population loss in one bloc (v2 definition, gross not excess over UN WPP). Warehousing assumed mortality-free (m8).
Timewave Zero is not used. Explosive-growth inputs enter only through m8 (Roodman 2020, Davidson 2021, Davidson & Houlden 2025, Forethought 2025).
China bloc's public already lacks political rights; 'held without rights after closure' for China means economically superfluous and warehoused/neglected, reported separately.
